It followed the caravan route northward across the mountains to Ladakh (Leh) in western Tibet, whence it entered southwestern Chinese Turkestan, the region of Sir Aurel Stein’s noted discoveries. In the Pialma oasis, nearly 100 miles west of Khotan, Buddhist stupas were discovered with some of the finest Gandhara sculpture yet found.
